mechanism: Rifampin is a potent inducer of CYP3A4 and other enzymes, significantly increasing the metabolism and clearance of methylprednisolone, reducing its therapeutic efficacy.
action: Increase methylprednisolone dose by 1.5-2 fold when used concurrently with rifampin; monitor clinical response closely and adjust dosing based on therapeutic outcomes; consider alternative anti-tuberculosis agents if possible.
